# Netx Ops for DeepSeek Harness
Network operations, topology and business monitoring tools for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web. Pub

## Install
In Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `github:hansjone/netxops`, or the absolute path to a rele
ased `dsh-netxops-<version>.tgz`. A release tarball is recommended for a fixed, tested version and a
voids downloading from GitHub during installation.
For the Web CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Only Netx Ops is required. IM delivery and scheduling are optional, separate plugins. Users do not n
eed Bun, Python, a local source checkout, or a build step; runtime JS and skills are included. Harne
ss supplies its own internal packages and React.
See the installation and troubleshooting guide.
## Configure

1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Netx Ops** and enter your Netx API URL and token.
2. Choose each capa
bility group's target presets. The default enables operations and business monitoring in Netx Ops on

ly; topology and publication to all presets start disabled.
3. After installation or upgrade, restar
t the relevant Desktop or Web Host once and select **Netx Ops** for a new session.
Publication switches and preset selection save automatically. Connection fields, model language, ala
rm settings and manually entered knowledge-base paths use **Save / Discard**, shown when a draft cha
nges. Choosing a knowledge-base directory through the picker saves that path automatically.
The master publication switch removes all plugin-managed Netx tools and skills while retaining selec
tions. Subsequent publication changes apply on the next model request without restarting. API access
requires a reachable Netx service and token permissions matching the requested tools.
Optional features include alarm delivery to a Harness session or IM, knowledge-base skills and local
memory, and downloading this Host's persisted sessions as a ZIP. See knowledge-base configuration a
nloading this Host's persisted sessions as a ZIP. See knowledge-base configuration and the tool map.
## Development and release
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Development requires Node.js 22, pnpm 11.7 and Bun 1.3.13 or later. Building and package installatio
n tests use only public development dependencies. Full Harness integration tests and type checking a
dditionally need a local Harness runtime; see maintainer instructions.
Release checks detect stale or missing bundles, undeclared runtime dependencies and invalid metadata
. Tests install the actual npm tarball offline in an isolated profile. CI repeats the package checks
on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Group skills (ops / topology / biz-monitor) are published by netx over `/mcp` `resources` and cached
under `$DSH_HOME/netxops-mcp-skills/`. This package does not ship skill files. Operator-subset KB p
ack skills remain local (see Knowledge base).
